subject: Pricing estimate & next steps for Fast Retail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Rivera <danielle@fastretail.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing estimate & next steps for Fast Retail

Hi Danielle —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Fast Retail's use case. Quick recap from my side:
- Goal: replace the current inference pipeline for product descriptions with lower-latency, cost-stable generation for peak daytime traffic.
- Key constraint: must fit within procurement's Q2 budget window and support EU data residency for some datasets.
- Next technical step: 20–30 min walkthrough of the attached pricing estimate so we can align on throughput targets and fallback policies.

I attached a tailored pricing estimate that includes: baseline hosted API usage, a dedicated capacity option, and an estimated delta for on-prem/private deployment (if needed). The file: FastRetail_Pricing_Estimate_2026-02.pdf (summary page + line-item appendix).

Would you be available for a short walkthrough this week or early next? Suggested times (PST):
- Thu 02/12, 10:30–11:00am
- Fri 02/13, 2:00–2:30pm
- Mon 02/16, 9:00–9:30am

If those don't work, send a couple windows that do and we’ll coordinate. Karthik (cc'd) can join to go deeper on throughput and deployment variants.

Thanks — happy to adapt the deck if you want a version focused solely on Dedicated capacity.

– Marissa

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference — inference you can rely on

Attachments: FastRetail_Pricing_Estimate_2026-02.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Rivera <danielle@fastretail.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing estimate & next steps for Fast Retail (quick check-in)

Hi Danielle —

Just bumping this in case the estimate landed in a busy week. Wanted to confirm you got FastRetail_Pricing_Estimate_2026-02.pdf and see whether it makes sense for a quick 20-min walkthrough so we can answer questions and lock on timing.

If helpful, Karthik can run the throughput/cost slides and I’ll cover contract/terms tradeoffs. Quick proposed slots (PST): Thu 02/19 11:00–11:30am or Thu 02/19 2:00–2:30pm. If neither work, tell me a day/time that does.

If procurement is still reviewing budget, a one-line update on timing would help us prioritize the right configuration.

Thanks — happy to jump on whatever cadence is easiest.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks for the follow-up and for the deck — I did receive it. Procurement is running the numbers but I wanted to get a quick sync with you and Karthik to clarify a couple line items (burst capacity pricing and the fallback model you recommended).

Thu 02/19 2:00–2:30pm PST works for me. Can you send a calendar invite? Also, is there a short one-page summary you can share that just lists the budget bands we discussed (hosted vs dedicated vs private) so I can pass that to procurement for an initial read?

Appreciate it — looking forward to the call.
